_comment: GitOps access-control config for dc-opportunities-v2. Edit this file and redeploy (infra) to change access. Consumed at deploy time by infra/main.bicep (loadJsonContent) and enforced at the Azure Front Door WAF.

admin._comment: Admin endpoint is reachable only from the ISP allowlist PLUS any explicit CIDRs listed here. Add your office/VPN egress IP (e.g. 203.0.113.10/32) to lock admin down to just your locations. Leave empty to allow admin from the full Ziggo/KPN ranges.

website._comment: Both public and admin endpoints are limited to these consumer ISPs. IP ranges live in config/isp-allowlist.json (regenerate with `npm run update-isp-allowlist`).
